case_number: 2025 INSC 51; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 4169/2024; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 139-140/2025

parties.respondent: Mathew K Cherian & ANR.; J. Ramesh

summary: Interpretation of Section 143 Railways Act, 1989; e-ticketing system not contemplated by statute at time of enactment; unauthorised creation of user IDs for ticket procurement; distinction between brick-and-mortar and online business; authorised agent exemption analysis; Kerala HC quashed proceedings, Madras HC refused quashment; statutory construction of penal provision; object of legislation examined; prima facie case requirement for criminal proceedings.
final_judgment: Kerala High Court judgment set aside; Madras High Court order upheld; criminal proceedings against Mathew K. Cherian restored; petitioners allowed to proceed with evidence before trial courts.
